summary: Listed on Forest Lookouts in McCurtain County and placed by TopoQuest at 1,745 ft; no source gives a build date, staffing or the tower's condition.

evidence.supports: tower in McCurtain County at 1745 ft MSL
evidence.quote: Flashman Lookout Tower is a tower located in McCurtain County, OK at N34.479823° W95.009677° (WGS84/NAD83) and at an elevation of 1745 ft MSL.
It can be seen on the USGS 1:24K topographic map Clebit, OK

evidence.supports: fire towers across southeastern Oklahoma from the 1920s
evidence.quote: During the 1920’s rapid expansion of state fire protection efforts and construction of fire lookout towers across southeastern Oklahoma occurred.

evidence.supports: 23 state fire towers at one time
evidence.quote: At one time, there were 23 state fire towers within the Oklahoma Forestry Services Fire Protection Area.
As fire tower observers have retired, they have been replaced by planes that fly over the area.

sources.title: History of the Oklahoma State Forestry Division

corrections.why: The only value on the Forest Lookouts page is a bare 'S'. The page does not explain it, and it does not name an agency.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the name, the county and a bare 'S'. TopoQuest gives coordinates (34.479823, -95.009677) and a map elevation of 1,745 ft, which is a map value for the spot, not a measured tower height. Two WebSearch queries and one state-history page found no build, staffing or fate record. The story is near the 120-word floor because the sources support little more. Next checks: Oklahoma Forestry Services tower records, McCurtain County newspapers, or the McCurtain County historical society.
